intent: Maintain the refined sensor positions and geometry from the previous iteration, as they have demonstrated excellent line following performance with zero line loss and low steering oscillation. Expect continued stable and smooth control with high completion rates on all tracks.
rationale: The previous iteration's refined sensor layout with a slightly forward front-center sensor at y=0.065 m and lateral sensors at y=0.045 m, sensor size 0.016 m, and wheel track 0.14 m achieved excellent race results with zero line loss and low steering oscillation. Integration feedback suggests that these positions optimize forward line sensing and lateral coverage, improving anticipation of line curvature and control smoothness. Given the strong performance and no negative feedback, I maintain all geometry parameters unchanged to preserve stability and line detection quality. I expect sustained zero line loss, low steering oscillation, and high completion rates on both oval and s-bend tracks. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, max_error, and steering_oscillation to confirm continued performance and control stability.
